items.reason: The R2 accessibility wording 'though the two contrasted so within, without the contrast was only in shades and shadows' is a garden path: 'without the contrast' parses as a prepositional phrase. Source: 'the contrast was only in shades and shadows without'. A comma after 'without' makes it read as the adverb (outside), matching the source's within/without pairing.
items.new: But though the two contrasted so within, without, the contrast was only in shades and shadows; those two seemed one — it was only the sex, as it were, that distinguished them.
